cases.req: In src/project-context.mjs, make the project-relative path validator also reject any path whose segments have leading or trailing whitespace.
Rename the field `references` in the object returned by the project context selection (exposed to users as `context` of the `start` command) to `rules`.
Make the `resume-context` command also print whether the current branch has an upstream tracking branch.
Approval envelopes must be valid for at most 12 hours instead of the current maximum.
The `worktree-create` error for a non-writable Git metadata directory should also include the issue number being created.
Add a new runtime module src/example-new.mjs that must ship to users in the package.
Add a Python helper script under scripts/ that formats release notes.
